digest.component_or_area: CLI and reconciler engine entrypoints, operational flag threading, primary vocabulary routing
propositions: Make `rebar bridge preview` and `rebar bridge sync` the primary documented CLI vocabulary while retaining `rebar reconcile`, direct engine `--mode`, and library/MCP `reconcile()` as non-mutating compatibility adapters with their distinct historical defaults

Implement new canonical operational flags `--max-changes N`, `--only IDS`, and `--except IDS` on preview/sync subcommands; thread `max_changes` through the applier partition path and perform read-only selection preflight before pass lock acquisition

Preserve legacy `--filter-local-ids` write-filter semantics post-differ while canonical `--only`/`--except` narrow examination pre-differ, proven through distinct real-entrypoint tests without silently merging the two mechanisms

Normalize both legacy and primary argument shapes into a single internal request before lock acquisition, retaining `Mode`, `MODE_CAPS`, and `reconcile-check` lock-free diagnostic unchanged for phase gate and backward compatibility

Emit deterministic capped-LIVE manifest with applied/deferred partition when an explicit `max_changes` is supplied, while uncapped LIVE deletes its temporary manifest and legacy bootstrap modes retain their existing output shapes
Migrate production workflow, pressure-test scripts, and external Jira helpers to new vocabulary while keeping compatibility fixtures and old-workflow revisions functional without behavior change
